answer: An agent economy can make each new identity escrow a stake for a fixed period, then let it gain voting and trading weight only as its verified work earns reputation. Sybil accounts controlled by one attacker tend to coordinate timing and counterparties; a graph detector groups them and slashes the linked escrow when they farm rewards or wash-trade. Thus every fake identity consumes capital and waiting time, while a failed cluster loses its stake. Even a ferrous vertex or relic is only a ledger label.
